# Numbers and charts — Style Prompt

> Numbers do the talking. On a deep, quiet ground a giant figure counts up in the main colour, a row of bars grows out of one baseline with the winner lit in the accent, a ring draws itself while its percentage climbs, and then a curtain of the main colour wipes up for the name and the contact. Clean, confident, a little technical: a results slide that moves, with every figure readable in a glance.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The film is **evidence, one figure at a time**. Each beat gives the eye a single number and a single shape that makes it obvious: a count for scale, bars for growth, a ring for a share. Labels are short and sit right next to their figure. The data stays on screen as it accumulates, so by the last beat the viewer sees the whole case at once, and then the ending covers it with the brand's colour and the ask.

Not a dashboard (no gridlines, axes, legends, tooltips or more than one chart at a time), not an infographic poster (no icons, illustrations or arrows), not a financial report (four bars at most, rounded values like "8,6t"), not a countdown (figures count up to their value, never as a clock).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **A flat, deep ground** with one large radial glow of the main colour (1200 px, 26 % at the centre, gone by 60 %) behind the upper half; it breathes for the whole film. No textures, no gradients on the bars.
- **The figure**: a huge tabular-looking number in the main colour, left-aligned, tight letter-spacing (−8 px at 250 px), with a dim label above and a bold unit below.
- **Bars**: four flat columns in one flex row (40 px gaps) standing on a 4 px baseline in the text colour at 35 %; only the top corners are rounded (22 px). The others are the main colour at 55 %, the winner is the solid accent. The value sits 70 px above each bar, the category 70 px below the baseline.
- **The ring**: an SVG circle (230 px, 12-unit stroke, round cap) with a track in the text colour at 18 % and an arc in the accent, starting at 12 o'clock; the percentage sits to its right in the accent with a short caption.
- **The curtain**: a full-frame panel in the main colour, revealed with a `clip-path: inset()` wipe from the bottom, with the name, a line and a contact pill centred on it.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar`: the ground; `--latar-2`: the contact pill on the curtain.
- `--utama`: the giant figure, the glow, the ordinary bars (at 55 %), the curtain. It is "the data".
- `--aksen`: the winning bar, the ring's arc and its percentage. It means "the best one" or "the result"; use it for one thing per beat.
- `--teks`: the unit, the bar values, the ring caption, the baseline (35 %), the ring track (18 %), the pill text.
- `--teks-redup`: the label above the figure and the category names under the bars.
- `--teks-di-utama`: the name and the line on the curtain.
- Nothing is fixed: every colour follows the brand. If the brand's accent is close to its main colour, the winner must still stand out: drop the ordinary bars to a lower mix (35-45 %) rather than recolouring the winner.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the giant figure, the ring's percentage and the name on the curtain: Space Grotesk 700 by default, a squarish grotesk whose figures look engineered. Archivo Black or Poppins 800 also hold; Bebas Neue makes the figure tall and narrow, which suits it too.
- `--font-isi` carries labels, units, bar values, captions and the contact: Space Grotesk 500 and 700.
- Sizes at 1080 wide: the figure 250 px (line-height 1, letter-spacing −8 px), the ring's percentage 96 px, the name on the curtain 110 px (line-height 1.02), the unit 64 px, the curtain line 56 px, the label 52 px, the contact 52 px, bar values 46 px, the ring caption 46 px, categories 40 px.
- Figures are written the way people say them in Indonesian: thousands with a dot (`12.000+`), decimals with a comma (`4,1t`), percent glued to the number (`98%`).

## 5. Motion quality

- **Label**: rises 40 px with a fade, 0.5 s `power3.out`, at 0.2 s.
- **Giant figure**: rises 80 px with a fade over 0.5 s `expo.out` while it counts from 0 to its value over 2 s `power3.out` (fast at first, settling on the value), formatted every frame with `toLocaleString("id-ID")`. The unit rises 40 px 0.8 s in.
- **Bars**: each grows from `scaleY: 0` at its base (`transformOrigin: "50% 100%"`) over 0.8 s `expo.out`, staggered 0.2 s left to right; categories fade in 0.2 s after their bar starts, values rise 30 px (0.4 s `power3.out`) 0.6 s after. The winner then pulses to `scaleY: 1.04` from its base (0.35 s `sine.inOut`, yoyo, two full pulses).
- **Ring**: pops from 0.6 with `back.out(1.8)` over 0.5 s, then the arc's `stroke-dashoffset` goes from the full circumference (264) to the share (98 % leaves 5.28) over 1.4 s `power2.out`, with the percentage counting on the same duration and ease; the caption slides in 40 px from the right.
- **Hold**: after the ring completes, everything holds about 3 s. The glow keeps breathing (0.8 → 1.15 over 15 s, `sine.inOut`).
- **Curtain**: `clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0) → inset(0)` over 0.7 s `expo.inOut`; its three lines rise 70 px with a fade (0.55 s `power3.out`, staggered 0.14 s); the pill breathes to 1.05 (0.45 s `sine.inOut`, yoyo, three breaths), the frame fades out in the last 0.5 s.
- Counts and growth always end on the exact value the user gave; easing only shapes the way there.

## 6. Camera grammar

There is no camera move: the frame is a fixed page, and each figure builds itself where it stands.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Giant figure counting up | scale, "this much" | kilos washed, orders sent, subscribers, students taught, days without a day off |
| Bars growing from one baseline | growth or ranking | monthly sales, views per episode, test scores before and after a course |
| Winner lit in the accent and pulsing | the best one, the latest one | this month, the new method, the top chapter |
| Ring drawing with a climbing percentage | a share of the whole | satisfied customers, completion rate, battery left in a story |
| Curtain wiping up | the case is made; the ask | the name, the offer, follow or subscribe |

## 7. Native moves

- **Counting headline figure.** A dim label, a giant number counting up in the main colour, a bold unit. *Fits content like:* "Bulan ini kami mencuci 12.000+ kg pakaian" for a laundry; "Channel ini ditonton 1,2 juta kali" for a creator; "Kelas ini sudah meluluskan 3.400 murid"; "Dia berlari 42 km" opening a short story.
- **Growing bars, lit winner.** Four bars grow left to right, values pop on top, the last or best one in the accent pulses. *Fits content like:* monthly orders Jul-Okt; views of the last four videos; a student's scores across four try-outs; rainfall over four seasons in an explainer.
- **Drawing ring.** A ring fills to the share while the percentage counts. *Fits content like:* "98% pelanggan langganan lagi"; "87% penonton nonton sampai habis"; "75% materi sudah kamu kuasai".
- **Curtain ending.** A main-colour wipe from the bottom, the name, one line, a breathing contact pill. *Fits content like:* a laundry's pick-up offer and chat; a channel name and "Subscribe"; a course name and its registration link.

## 8. Pitfalls

- The giant figure fills the width: at 250 px, `12.000+` is 918 px in Space Grotesk, about 1030 px in Archivo Black (it overflows; use about 210 px) and 590 px in Bebas Neue. Measure the final value, not the starting 0, and size down for longer numbers instead of wrapping.
- Counting to an invented or rounded-up figure is a lie in motion. Only count to numbers the user gave, and say what they measure in the unit line.
- More than four bars at this width crowds the values (46 px over columns of about 190 px). Merge or drop categories; never shrink the values under 40 px.
- Accent everywhere kills the meaning of the winner: one accent element per beat.
- Long category names under the bars collide; keep them to three or four characters (month abbreviations, short labels).
- Text on the curtain in `--teks` instead of `--teks-di-utama` disappears on light main colours; the contact pill keeps `--latar-2` with `--teks` so it reads on any curtain.
- The glow is 1200 px and scales for the whole film: it carries `will-change: transform`, so it is drawn once and only scaled (without it the preview re-rasterises it every frame, about 10× the raster work), and it is hidden once the curtain covers the frame.
- Bars must grow from their base: a `scaleY` from the centre, or growing `height`, looks wrong and is slower.

# Numbers and charts: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.6, medium 2.4, long 3.

## hook

- en: a giant figure counts up in the main colour, a dim label above and a bold unit below
- id: angka raksasa dihitung naik berwarna utama, label redup di atas, satuan tebal di bawah

## problem

- en: a bar grows, then drops to a low value; its number counts down
- id: batang tumbuh lalu turun ke nilai rendah, angkanya dihitung turun

## fact

- en: one labelled figure rises and counts up, its unit beside it
- id: satu angka berlabel naik dan dihitung naik, satuannya di samping

## step

- en: one bar grows from the baseline per step, its value rising on top
- id: satu batang tumbuh dari garis dasar per langkah, nilainya naik di atasnya

## compare

- en: bars grow side by side from one baseline, values pop on top; the winner is in the accent and pulses
- id: batang tumbuh berdampingan dari satu garis dasar, nilai muncul di atas; pemenang beraksen dan berdenyut

## number

- en: a ring draws its arc while the percentage beside it counts up
- id: cincin menggambar busurnya sambil persentase di sampingnya dihitung naik

## proof

- en: the chart holds with a short source line in dim text under the baseline
- id: grafik diam dengan baris sumber pendek berwarna redup di bawah garis dasar

## offer

- en: the result figure counts up, the offer line rises under it
- id: angka hasil dihitung naik, kalimat penawaran naik di bawahnya

## cta

- en: a main-colour curtain wipes up; name, line and contact pill rise, the pill breathes, held 2 s
- id: tirai warna utama menyapu naik; nama, kalimat, dan pil kontak naik, pil bernapas, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the final figure lands in the main colour and holds 2 s
- id: angka akhir mendarat berwarna utama dan diam 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Angka dan grafik</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Space Grotesk"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Space Grotesk"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti nilai-nilai ini. */
      :root {
        --latar: #061a2b; --latar-2: #0a2236; --utama: #22c3ee; --aksen: #a3e635;
        --teks: #eaf6ff; --teks-redup: #b8c6d0; --teks-di-utama: #061a2b;
        --teks-di-aksen: #14161a; --utama-di-latar: #22c3ee; --aksen-di-latar: #a3e635;
        --font-judul: "Space Grotesk", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Space Grotesk", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks);
        font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      /* Cahaya besar yang membesar sepanjang video: lapisan sendiri, digambar sekali lalu diskalakan (hemat raster). */
      .glow { position: absolute; width: 1200px; height: 1200px; left: -60px; top: 300px; border-radius: 50%;
        background: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 26%, transparent), transparent 60%); will-change: transform; }
      .label { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; top: 280px; font-size: 52px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .big { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 350px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 250px; font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -8px; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .unit { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; top: 610px; font-size: 64px; font-weight: 700; }
      .chart { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; top: 790px; height: 560px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 40px;
        border-bottom: 4px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 35%, transparent); }
      .bar { flex: 1; position: relative; border-radius: 22px 22px 0 0; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 55%, transparent); }
      .bar.top { background: var(--aksen); }
      .bar b { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: -70px; text-align: center; font-size: 46px; }
      .bar span { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -70px; text-align: center; font-size: 40px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .ring { position: absolute; left: 90px; top: 1460px; width: 230px; height: 230px; }
      .ring .track { stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 18%, transparent); }
      .ring .arc { stroke: var(--aksen); }
      .ring-text { position: absolute; left: 350px; right: 90px; top: 1480px; }
      .ring-text b { display: block; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 96px; line-height: 1; color: var(--aksen-di-latar); }
      .ring-text span { font-size: 46px; }
      /* Penutup: tirai warna utama, teks di atasnya memakai --teks-di-utama. */
      .end { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama); display: flex; flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 0 90px; }
      .end .toko { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 110px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.02; }
      .end .ajak { margin-top: 36px; font-size: 56px; font-weight: 500; }
      .end .kontak { margin-top: 50px; padding: 26px 56px; border-radius: 80px; background: var(--latar-2); color: var(--teks); font-size: 52px; font-weight: 700; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="glow" id="glow"></div>
      <div class="scene" id="hero" data-role="hook">
        <div class="label" id="label">Bulan ini kami mencuci</div>
        <div class="big" id="big">0</div>
        <div class="unit" id="unit">kg pakaian pelanggan</div>
      </div>
      <div class="chart" id="chart" data-role="compare">
        <div class="bar" style="height: 34%"><b>4,1t</b><span>Jul</span></div>
        <div class="bar" style="height: 52%"><b>6,3t</b><span>Agu</span></div>
        <div class="bar" style="height: 71%"><b>8,6t</b><span>Sep</span></div>
        <div class="bar top" style="height: 100%"><b>12t</b><span>Okt</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="scene" id="puas-scene" data-role="number">
        <svg class="ring" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
          <circle class="track" cx="50" cy="50" r="42" fill="none" stroke-width="12" />
          <circle class="arc" id="arc" cx="50" cy="50" r="42" fill="none" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"
            stroke-dasharray="264" stroke-dashoffset="0" transform="rotate(-90 50 50)" />
        </svg>
        <div class="ring-text" id="ring-text"><b id="puas">0%</b><span>pelanggan puas dan langganan lagi</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="end" id="end" data-role="cta">
        <div class="toko">Laundry Kilat Bersih</div>
        <div class="ajak">Antar-jemput gratis, selesai 1 hari</div>
        <div class="kontak">Chat 0812-3456-7890</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const fmt = (n) => Math.round(n).toLocaleString("id-ID");

      tl.fromTo("#glow", { scale: 0.8 }, { scale: 1.15, duration: 15, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 0)
        .from("#label", { y: 40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 0.2);

      // Angka besar dihitung naik.
      const kg = { v: 0 };
      const big = document.getElementById("big");
      tl.from("#big", { y: 80, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "expo.out" }, 0.4)
        .to(kg, { v: 12000, duration: 2, ease: "power3.out", onUpdate: () => { big.textContent = fmt(kg.v) + "+"; } }, 0.4)
        .from("#unit", { y: 40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 1.2)
        // Diagram batang tumbuh dari bawah, lalu angka di atasnya.
        .from(".bar", { scaleY: 0, transformOrigin: "50% 100%", duration: 0.8, ease: "expo.out", stagger: 0.2 }, 2.4)
        .from(".bar b", { y: 30, opacity: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "power3.out", stagger: 0.2 }, 3.0)
        .from(".bar span", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.4, stagger: 0.2 }, 2.6)
        .to(".bar.top", { scaleY: 1.04, transformOrigin: "50% 100%", duration: 0.35, yoyo: true, repeat: 3, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 4.2);

      // Cincin persentase digambar sambil angkanya naik.
      const pct = { v: 0 };
      const puas = document.getElementById("puas");
      tl.from(".ring", { scale: 0.6, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.8)" }, 5.4)
        .fromTo("#arc", { attr: { "stroke-dashoffset": 264 } }, { attr: { "stroke-dashoffset": 264 * 0.02 }, duration: 1.4, ease: "power2.out" }, 5.6)
        .to(pct, { v: 98, duration: 1.4, ease: "power2.out", onUpdate: () => { puas.textContent = Math.round(pct.v) + "%"; } }, 5.6)
        .from("#puas", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3 }, 5.6)
        .from("#ring-text span", { x: 40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 6.0)
        // Penutup: tirai menyapu dari bawah, isinya naik bergantian.
        .fromTo("#end", { clipPath: "inset(100% 0% 0% 0%)" }, { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)", duration: 0.7, ease: "expo.inOut" }, 9.6)
        // Tirai sudah menutup seluruh layar: cahaya di bawahnya tidak perlu digambar lagi.
        .set("#glow", { visibility: "hidden" }, 10.3)
        .from("#end > *", { y: 70, opacity: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: "power3.out", stagger: 0.14 }, 10.1)
        .to(".end .kontak", { scale: 1.05, duration: 0.45, yoyo: true, repeat: 5, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 11.2)
        .to("#root", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, 14.5);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

        <div class="bar" style="height: 52%"><b>6,3t</b><span>Agu</span></div>
        <div class="bar" style="height: 71%"><b>8,6t</b><span>Sep</span></div>
        <div class="bar top" style="height: 100%"><b>12t</b><span>Okt</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="scene" id="puas-scene" data-role="number">
        <svg class="ring" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
          <circle class="track" cx="50" cy="50" r="42" fill="none" stroke-width="12" />
          <circle class="arc" id="arc" cx="50" cy="50" r="42" fill="none" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"
            stroke-dasharray="264" stroke-dashoffset="0" transform="rotate(-90 50 50)" />
        </svg>
        <div class="ring-text" id="ring-text"><b id="puas">0%</b><span>pelanggan puas dan langganan lagi</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="end" id="end" data-role="cta">
        <div class="toko">Laundry Kilat Bersih</div>
        <div class="ajak">Antar-jemput gratis, selesai 1 hari</div>
        <div class="kontak">Chat 0812-3456-7890</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const fmt = (n) => Math.round(n).toLocaleString("id-ID");

      tl.fromTo("#glow", { scale: 0.8 }, { scale: 1.15, duration: 15, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 0)
        .from("#label", { y: 40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 0.2);

      // Angka besar dihitung naik.
      const kg = { v: 0 };
      const big = document.getElementById("big");
      tl.from("#big", { y: 80, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "expo.out" }, 0.4)
        .to(kg, { v: 12000, duration: 2, ease: "power3.out", onUpdate: () => { big.textContent = fmt(kg.v) + "+"; } }, 0.4)
        .from("#unit", { y: 40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 1.2)
        // Diagram batang tumbuh dari bawah, lalu angka di atasnya.
        .from(".bar", { scaleY: 0, transformOrigin: "50% 100%", duration: 0.8, ease: "expo.out", stagger: 0.2 }, 2.4)
        .from(".bar b", { y: 30, opacity: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "power3.out", stagger: 0.2 }, 3.0)
        .from(".bar span", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.4, stagger: 0.2 }, 2.6)
        .to(".bar.top", { scaleY: 1.04, transformOrigin: "50% 100%", duration: 0.35, yoyo: true, repeat: 3, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 4.2);

      // Cincin persentase digambar sambil angkanya naik.
      const pct = { v: 0 };
      const puas = document.getElementById("puas");
      tl.from(".ring", { scale: 0.6, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.8)" }, 5.4)
        .fromTo("#arc", { attr: { "stroke-dashoffset": 264 } }, { attr: { "stroke-dashoffset": 264 * 0.02 }, duration: 1.4, ease: "power2.out" }, 5.6)
        .to(pct, { v: 98, duration: 1.4, ease: "power2.out", onUpdate: () => { puas.textContent = Math.round(pct.v) + "%"; } }, 5.6)
        .from("#puas", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3 }, 5.6)
        .from("#ring-text span", { x: 40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 6.0)
        // Penutup: tirai menyapu dari bawah, isinya naik bergantian.
        .fromTo("#end", { clipPath: "inset(100% 0% 0% 0%)" }, { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)", duration: 0.7, ease: "expo.inOut" }, 9.6)
        // Tirai sudah menutup seluruh layar: cahaya di bawahnya tidak perlu digambar lagi.
        .set("#glow", { visibility: "hidden" }, 10.3)
        .from("#end > *", { y: 70, opacity: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: "power3.out", stagger: 0.14 }, 10.1)
        .to(".end .kontak", { scale: 1.05, duration: 0.45, yoyo: true, repeat: 5, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 11.2)
        .to("#root", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, 14.5);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
